exposure: Prenatal diagnosis of CHD vs. postnatal diagnosis of CHD
outcome: Urgent CD due to non-reassuring fetal monitor (NRFHR)
cohort: 1598 neonates with CHD (688 diagnosed prenatally) and 85,576 singleton controls
finding: Prenatal diagnosis of CHD was associated with an increased rate of induction of labor, but not with an increased rate of CD or CD due to NRFHR.
mod_finding: Prenatal diagnosis of CHD did not affect the mode of delivery, including the rate of CD and CD due to non-reassuring fetal heart rate (NRFHR).
birth_weight: Significantly lower in pregnancies with CHD compared to controls
